name: Avnet
outlook:
What Avnet says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: sales growthThe second quarter guidance implies sequential sales growth of approximately 5% at the midpoint and 12% when adjusting for the impact of the extra week of sales in the first quarter.
  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: tax rate and share countThe second quarter guidance assumes similar interest expense to the first quarter of fiscal 2027 and an adjusted effective tax rate of between 21% and 25%. The second quarter guidance assumes 87 million average diluted shares outstanding.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
